description.label: Description
description.value:
The bullet, having the temerity to deform and flatten out for maximum tissue damage, tears through your abdominal cavity one side to the other, making a spectacular exit hole through which your torn-up intestines start spilling. Yuck!

Effects: Nope…not really something a surgeon can fix! Really. Maybe a magician or a priestess of Shallya? The only thing that can save your life is a spell or prayer** within your Toughness Bonus turns, in which case you’ll live but gain @Condition[Fatigued] (4). Otherwise you’ll perish.

No Extraction is necessary.
